scripts.infra:reset-db-vol: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker volume create infra_postgres_data
scripts.infra:reset-db: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && concurrently -n infra,backend,frontend -c magenta,blue,green "npm run infra:logs" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
